description: Print-production document (pdfnative 1.7 via generate_basic_pdf v1.6.0): a 3 mm bleed (8.5 pt) derives the TrimBox/BleedBox, `marks: true` draws crop + registration marks outside the trim, `metadata.trapped` records the /Trapped flag for the prepress workflow and `viewerPreferences.duplex` pre-sets double-sided printing in the Print dialog. Self-contained: runs end-to-end with no placeholders. Omit `print`, `metadata` and the duplex preference for byte-stable office output.

blocks.text: This page carries a 3 mm bleed with crop and registration marks so the print shop can trim it accurately.

items: TrimBox and BleedBox set from the bleed shorthand
